⚠️⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR U.S. RESIDENTS ⚠️⚠️

Good news: you will NOT pay any import duties, customs fees or brokerage charges on your order. We prepay all U.S. duties ourselves before your labels leave Canada, so nothing is collected from you at delivery.

Your order ships directly from Quebec, Canada with Canada Post and is handed over to USPS once it reaches the United States, so it arrives at your door like any other domestic package.

Thank you for supporting a small handmade shop 💙

{group_name} name labels for kids — personalized, laminated vinyl stickers for school supplies, daycare bottles, lunch boxes, shoes and clothing tags. Choose your design, your bundle and your font: every label is printed with your child's name.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO ORDER

1. Choose your bundle (first drop-down).
2. Choose your design (second drop-down) — see the numbered design chart in the photos.
3. In the personalization box, write the name (and an optional second line) and the font number from the font chart.
4. We send you a proof to check the spelling before we print.
